caption: The video captures a fixed view of a rocky mountain creek where water is already in continuous motion. In the left foreground a large lichen-mottled boulder rises, its base fringed by a few small green leafy plants that hold still throughout. At the bottom center a flat speckled rock supports a single thin bare twig that leans upward without swaying. The mid-right of the frame is dominated by a churning pool of white, aerated water that boils over submerged stones, its bubble patterns and eddies reshaping and drifting downstream from moment to moment. In the upper-left background a small waterfall sheets steadily down a smooth pale rock slab, its surface texture flickering as the flow maintains a roughly constant form. To the right a jumble of tan boulders borders a calmer, brownish-tinted pool where ripples and reflections shift subtly. The rocks, plants and twig remain locked in the same positions, indicating a stationary camera. The only visible activity is the relentless movement of the water. It flows on past the final frame without resolving or stopping.
